assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset: original newspaper-like explanatory infographic to insert in a Korean university partnership proposal.
Primary request: communicate the proposed sequence of student support in five clear left-to-right stages, each with one dimensional pictogram above a compact card. This is a proposed operating flow, not automatic admission or employment.
Exact title: '대학 협력의 단계별 흐름'.
Exact stage labels: '모집·선발' → '준비교육' → '입학 준비' → '재학 지원' → '진로·기업 연계'.
Under each stage, exact short caption respectively: '대학 기준 확인', '한국어·전공 기초', '서류·일정 인계', '학업·생활 상담', '직무·체류 요건 확인'.
Pictograms: application folder and student silhouette; open book and simple tools; university and document folder; book and speech bubble; job portfolio with a magnifying glass. No job success or visa approval pictograms.
Bottom: separate three small decision chips with exact text '입학 결정: 대학' / '채용 결정: 기업' / '체류허가: 출입국관서'.
Exact final note: '운영 범위와 일정은 협약으로 확정합니다.'
Original Korean newspaper-style explanatory infographic for a formal university partnership proposal. Clean white and very pale blue background, navy #0F2E54 headings, brand blue #174EA6 and cyan #069EEA accents, charcoal body text. Polished dimensional pictograms and soft shadows paired with crisp aligned information cards and generous whitespace. Elegant, informative and highly readable at 480pt width in an A4 document. A single landscape infographic about 2:1 aspect ratio, large clear Korean typography, very few exact words, no paragraphs of tiny text. Precisely spell provided Korean labels, no extra letters or slogans. No newsroom branding, logos, statistics, government seals, visas, approval certificates or promised outcomes. Every educational/procedural scene is conceptual. Respectful tiny adult figures if useful. Cards, arrows and icons should communicate the logic accurately; arrows between proposed operating stages do not promise admission, job or immigration approval.
Typography should have title about 75px, stage labels about 60px and short sublabels at least 42px on a 2000×1000 landscape canvas. No other text.

Primary request: show a five-step student support loop with polished dimensional pictograms and accurate process arrows.
Exact title: '학업 적응을 위한 지원 과정'.

Exact short sublabels respectively: '출결·과제·성적', '언어·수업·생활', '원인과 대응 방향', '보충학습·상담', '기록과 후속 조치'.

Two separated footer statements, exact text: '학사 결정은 대학의 기준을 따릅니다.' and '필요한 정보는 동의와 업무 범위에 따라 공유합니다.'
